properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

ApplicationList.description: The response of the list applications operation.

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items.

ApplicationProperties.description: Properties of an installed application inventory item.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

publisher.description: Vendor or publisher of the application.

architecture.description: CPU architecture of the installed package.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the application.

productCode.description: Product code that identifies the installed application.

packageCode.description: Package code that identifies the installed package.

installDate.description: Date and time the application was installed.

installLocation.description: Filesystem path where the application is installed.

installSource.description: Original media path or URL the installer was run from.

packageSource.description: Source from which the application package was installed.

url.description: URL associated with the installed application.

uninstallString.description: Registry-derived command to remove the application.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

CertificateList.description: The response of the list certificates operation.

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items.

CertificateProperties.description: Properties of a certificate inventory item.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

subject.description: Subject distinguished name of the certificate.

issuer.description: Distinguished name of the certificate authority that issued the certificate.

notBefore.description: Start date of the certificate validity period.

thumbprint.description: SHA-1 hash of the certificate (legacy thumbprint).

serialNumber.description: Serial number assigned to the certificate by its issuer.

hasPrivateKey.description: Whether the certificate has an associated private key.

keySize.description: Length of the public key in bits.

keyUsage.description: Key usage flags defining permitted cryptographic operations.

eku.description: Extended key usage purposes (Server Auth, Client Auth, Code Signing, etc.).

san.description: Subject alternative names (SANs) from the certificate.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

biosVersion.description: The BIOS version reported by the system.

biosReleaseDate.description: The BIOS release date reported by the system.

firmwareClass.description: The list of firmware class identifiers (typically GUIDs).

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

GroupList.description: The response of the list groups operation.

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items.

GroupProperties.description: Properties of a group inventory item.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

localAccount.description: Whether this group is a local account.

comment.description: Free-text comment describing the group's purpose.

members.description: List of user accounts and/or nested groups that are members of this group.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

ServiceList.description: The response of the list services operation.

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items.

ServiceProperties.description: Properties of a service inventory item.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the Services console.

serviceType.description: Classification of the service (own process, shared, kernel driver, etc.).

description.description: Free-text summary of what the service does.

status.description: Current runtime state: Running, Stopped, Paused.

state.description: Detailed runtime state including transitional states.

processId.description: The OS process ID (PID) of the running service instance.

startType.description: How the service is configured to launch (Auto, Manual, Disabled).

pathName.description: Fully qualified path to the service binary.

userName.description: The account name under which the service runs.

acceptPause.description: Whether the service can be paused and resumed.

acceptStop.description: Whether the service can be stopped.

exitCode.description: The exit code from the last service termination.

errorControl.description: Severity of the error if this service fails to start during startup.

checkPoint.description: The checkpoint value from the last service state update.

desktopInteract.description: Whether the service can interact with the desktop.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

UserList.description: The response of the list users operation.

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items.

UserProperties.description: Properties of a user account inventory item.

lastObservedAt.description: The date and time when the inventory item was last observed on the machine.

fullName.description: The full display name of the user.

description.description: Free-text description of the account's purpose.

sid.description: The Security Identifier — unique, immutable ID.

domain.description: The domain or machine name the account belongs to.

enabled.description: Whether the account is currently active and can log in.

lockout.description: Whether the account is currently locked out.

userPasswordChangePermission.description: Whether the user is allowed to change their own password.

passwordExpires.description: Whether the account's password has an expiration date set.

passwordLastSet.description: The date and time when the password was last changed.

passwordRequired.description: Whether a password is required to log in.

accountExpires.description: The date when the entire account expires.
